about: NorthStar's curated opportunities. Real, long-running programs. Deadlines, fees and rules change every year, so each entry stays marked 'not yet checked' (verified_on: null) until a person checks the official page and fills in verified_on (and deadline, if there is one). NorthStar never registers anyone.

opportunities.title: Technovation Girls
opportunities.summary: Teams design and build a mobile or AI app that tackles a problem in their community, then pitch it.
opportunities.eligibility: Girls and gender-diverse young people aged 8-18
opportunities.time_commitment: A season of about 12 weeks, a few hours a week

opportunities.title: FIRST LEGO League
opportunities.summary: Teams build and program LEGO robots for a themed challenge and present an innovation project.
opportunities.eligibility: Students aged about 9-16, through a registered team (often a school or club)
opportunities.cost: Team fees vary - check with your team or school
opportunities.time_commitment: A season of several months, weekly team meetings

opportunities.title: FIRST Tech Challenge
opportunities.summary: Teams design, build and code a robot to compete in an alliance-based game against other teams.
opportunities.eligibility: Students aged about 12-18, through a registered team
opportunities.cost: Team fees vary - check with your team or school
opportunities.time_commitment: A season of several months, several hours a week

opportunities.title: World Robot Olympiad
opportunities.summary: Teams build robots for challenge categories such as robot missions, future innovators and robot sports.
opportunities.eligibility: Students aged about 8-19, through national organizers
opportunities.cost: Varies by country - check your national organizer
opportunities.time_commitment: Months of team preparation before national rounds

opportunities.title: NASA International Space Apps Challenge
opportunities.summary: A worldwide hackathon where teams use NASA's open data to solve challenges about Earth and space.
opportunities.eligibility: Open to all ages; under-18s need a parent or guardian's consent

opportunities.title: Conrad Challenge
opportunities.summary: Teams develop an innovative, science-based product or solution and present it like a start-up.

opportunities.title: Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair
opportunities.summary: The world's largest pre-college science fair. Students qualify through an affiliated local or regional fair.
opportunities.eligibility: High-school students (grades 9-12 or equivalent) who win at an affiliated fair

opportunities.title: Congressional App Challenge
opportunities.summary: Students build an app and submit it in their congressional district's competition.
opportunities.eligibility: Middle- and high-school students in participating U.S. districts
opportunities.time_commitment: A few weeks to a few months, at your own pace

opportunities.title: Indian Olympiad Qualifier in Mathematics (IOQM)
opportunities.organizer: HBCSE and the Mathematics Teachers' Association
opportunities.summary: The first stage of India's mathematical olympiad programme, leading towards the International Mathematical Olympiad.
opportunities.eligibility: School students in about classes 8-12 in India
opportunities.cost: Small exam fee - check the official page
opportunities.time_commitment: Self-study over months; one exam day

opportunities.title: INSPIRE-MANAK
opportunities.organizer: Department of Science and Technology & National Innovation Foundation, India
opportunities.summary: Students submit original ideas or innovations that solve everyday problems; selected ideas get support to build a model.
opportunities.eligibility: School students in about classes 6-10 in India, nominated through their school
opportunities.time_commitment: Submitting an idea is quick; building a model takes weeks if selected

opportunities.title: ATL Marathon
opportunities.summary: Teams from Atal Tinkering Labs identify a community problem and build a working prototype solution.
opportunities.eligibility: School students, usually through a school with an Atal Tinkering Lab

opportunities.title: Bebras Computational Thinking Challenge
opportunities.summary: A short puzzle challenge about computational thinking - no coding needed - usually taken at school.
opportunities.eligibility: School students, usually entered by their school
opportunities.cost: Often free through schools - check your national organizer

opportunities.title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
opportunities.summary: A free, self-paced introduction to computer science and programming, from Scratch to Python and web basics.
opportunities.time_commitment: About 10-20 hours per week if you go fast; self-paced

opportunities.title: Kaggle Learn courses
opportunities.summary: Short, free, hands-on courses in Python, data analysis, data visualisation and machine learning.
opportunities.eligibility: Kaggle accounts have a minimum age - check Kaggle's terms
